tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// a tsa ra la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅// mi gang dal ba 'byor pa thob gyur cing*// bstan pa bdud rtsi'i sgo mor zhugs gyur nas// brtul zhugs bzang po'i sdom pa khas blangs te// blang dang dor ba'i de nyid shes bzhin du// tshe 'di'i bde dang mdza' bshes don dang ni// rnyed dang snying po med dang grags pa'i phyir// rnal 'byor mi brtson brtul zhugs nyams byed pa// 'di las blun pa srid pa gsum na gang*// phun sum tshogs kyang bde la ma chags dang*// 'di yi don du rnal 'byor mi 'dor dang*// nyon mongs skyes tshe bslab pa rjes dran pa// dam pa yin par khyod kyis cis mi shes// 'di 'dra'i tshul la tshul bzhin shes tsam gyis// chog pa nyid du chog shes mi byed pa// yang nas yang du rnam par spyad bya zhing*// sgom pa goms pa ngang gis 'phel ba dang*// bde ba myong tshe gzhan la ster ba dang*// sdug bsngal myong tshe gzhan phyir brnag pa dang*// btang snyoms tshe na zhi la mnyam 'jog pa'i// chos tshul gsum la khyod yid nan tan byos// sngon gyi dam pas nyams su bzhes nas bsrungs// kho bos thos nas yid dbang nges par 'gyur// nges pa ji bzhin brtse bas gdams 'di la// g.yel ba ma byed shes ldan 'byor pa ste// de ltar kun nas 'dams pa'i rten du ni// bdud rtsi ril bu lnga phrag bcu ster gyi// phyi dang nang gi rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun// mchod nas rtag pa'i dngos grub blang bar gyis// lcags mo lug gi lo mchod pa'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu bdun gyi srod kyi cha la shing kun mkhar du bris pa'i yi ge bkra shis par gyur cig a tsa ra la gdams pa'i spring yig go/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
